scope: One source-bound session-0 SIMLOX 2017 CLI lifecycle: normal JSON import/export/calc/report, -convert on a copied input document, and one deliberately invalid inactive BASE-01 source whose zero-exit calculation must not be classified as a usable result.

dependency.behavior: Accepted K02.var01 named Station JSON input/roundtrip and h7/h8/h11 mission result; GUI views and inactive-row losslessness are not inherited.

manual.basis: Installed manual documents -silent, -jimport, -jexport, -calc, -jsonreport, -log, -convert, -threads and file-first argument order. It does not by itself prove native output or the error boundary.

positive_gate: Fresh copied K02 source imports and exports with all authored rows preserved subject to the accepted native-added empty default Station instance; converter Errors 0, expected warnings #108/#126, non-four-byte SXO, h7 order/h8 launch/h11 completion, one ready terminal aircraft, and native event/report parity with accepted K02.
copy_convert_gate: Copy the freshly imported SXI, run -convert only on that isolated copy, confirm original SXI hash unchanged and converted copy remains nonempty/readable. A same-version no-op is allowed; no old-version migration claim follows.
negative_gate: Add only Station K02-BASE inactive_rows=[1] to the accepted source. Native import/export must finish; calculation process exit alone is insufficient. If converter errors occur, require a four-byte unusable SXO and no event/report acceptance; if it unexpectedly converts cleanly, preserve the raw outcome as a hypothesis failure rather than inventing rejection.
execution_guard: Session-0 SSH, sshd ancestry, Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue, GUI PID 13340/session 1 identity and active session, one immutable run directory, 60-second native-child watchdog, source/tool hashes before and after, raw SHA-256 closure.
limits: GUI Test is not exercised; K07.var01 stays unverified.
